forward_language.name: Forward Language
forward_language.root: Alice -> encode -> bounded channel -> decode -> Bob -> witness/ack -> return path

roles.Encoder: maps source state into channel-compatible symbols
roles.Channel: bounded medium that may delay, lose, corrupt, reorder, or transform
roles.Bob: destination that reconstructs or acts on the received state
roles.Witness: observes result without silently rewriting intent

forward_language.toroid: The return path closes the loop. This is an OaSIs architectural analogy, not a claim that Internet protocols or physical space are literally toroidal.

architecture.root_pattern: Alice -> encode -> bounded box/channel -> decode -> Bob -> witness/ack -> Alice

ELECTRONICS.keep: digital state + explicit timing + measured boundaries
ELECTRONICS.retire: assuming abstraction removes analog realities such as noise, leakage, timing, power
ELECTRONICS.integrate: every digital box has physical signal/power/timing witnesses

NETWORKING.keep: layered packet network, explicit endpoints, secure transport, naming indirection
NETWORKING.retire: new protocols designed around obsolete TLS versions; treating RFC793 as the current TCP base spec
NETWORKING.integrate: TLS 1.3 baseline, QUIC/HTTP3 where useful, PQ transition/algorithm agility

STORAGE_ISOLATION.keep: separate logical, cryptographic, DMA/controller, physical, and sanitization boundaries
STORAGE_ISOLATION.retire: calling partitions, folders, or deletion strong isolation
STORAGE_ISOLATION.integrate: encryption + key boundary; read-only/offline where appropriate; IOMMU/device separation for DMA paths; physical disconnect for stronger isolation; NIST-style validation for sanitization

JAVA.keep: JVM portability, type safety, managed memory, compatibility, explicit modules, six-month evolution
JAVA.retire: applets and dependence on JDK internals; treating old LTS as the whole language
JAVA.integrate: operate on an LTS when stability requires it while tracking current SE 27 specification

FENG_SHUI_SPATIAL.keep: circulation, orientation, sightlines, clutter reduction, light, personal/cultural meaning as design heuristics
FENG_SHUI_SPATIAL.retire: presenting qi or auspicious mappings as experimentally established engineering quantities
FENG_SHUI_SPATIAL.integrate: test practical layout choices with observation, accessibility, environmental data, and user preference

ART_BEAUTY.keep: contrast, hierarchy, negative space, grouping, rhythm, legibility, cultural/contextual meaning
ART_BEAUTY.retire: beauty as a single universal numeric truth or decoration that destroys usability
ART_BEAUTY.integrate: content-first hierarchy + progressive disclosure + accessibility + individual taste
